title: Pope Leo Diagnosed with Lung Cancer After Successful Surgery
subtitle: The 71-year-old leader of the Roman Catholic Church is recovering in a Rome hospital following a procedure to remove a growth from his lung.

summary.en: Pope Leo has been diagnosed with lung cancer after doctors found a growth on his lung. The 71-year-old leader underwent a successful surgery to remove part of his right lung. Vatican officials confirmed the diagnosis after tests were completed during the operation. The Pope is currently resting in a hospital in Rome and has cancelled his public meetings until October 20. Church leaders are hopeful for his recovery as the condition was caught early.
summary.zh: 教宗利奧在醫師發現肺部腫塊後，被診斷出罹患肺癌。這位七十一歲的領袖接受了成功的手術，切除部分右肺。梵蒂岡官員在手術期間完成檢測後證實了診斷結果。教宗目前正在羅馬的醫院休養，並已取消直到十月二十日的所有公開會議。由於病情發現得早，教會領袖對他的康復抱持希望。

paragraphs.en: The Vatican announced on Tuesday that Pope Leo, the leader of the Roman Catholic Church, has been diagnosed with lung cancer. The 71-year-old Pope underwent a medical procedure to remove the lower part of his right lung after doctors discovered a growth. According to a medical bulletin released by the Vatican, the operation was successful and followed the original plan. The surgery lasted about 90 minutes, and the Pope spent a total of three hours in the operating theatre.
paragraphs.zh: 梵蒂岡週二宣布，羅馬天主教會領袖教宗利奧（Pope Leo）被診斷出罹患肺癌。這位七十一歲的教宗在醫師發現腫塊後，接受了切除右肺下葉的醫療手術。根據梵蒂岡發布的醫療公報，手術過程順利且符合原定計畫。手術歷時約九十分鐘，教宗在手術室內總共待了三個小時。

paragraphs.en: Before the surgery, Pope Leo had been open about his health with the public. During his Sunday prayer in St Peter’s Square, he told the crowds that doctors had found a small nodule—a small, solid lump of tissue—on his lung during a routine checkup. He explained that the growth was detected early and was well-contained. Following the advice of his medical team, the Pope decided to have the operation to remove it. The Vatican noted that the diagnosis of lung adenocarcinoma was suspected before the surgery and confirmed while the doctors were operating.
paragraphs.zh: 手術前，教宗利奧曾向大眾公開自己的健康狀況。在聖伯多祿廣場的週日祈禱中，他告訴群眾，醫師在例行檢查時發現他肺部有一個小結節，也就是一塊小的實體組織腫塊。他解釋說，該腫瘤發現得早且控制良好。聽從醫療團隊的建議後，教宗決定接受手術將其切除。梵蒂岡指出，手術前曾懷疑是肺腺癌，並在醫師進行手術時獲得證實。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo, who was born in Chicago, became the leader of the Roman Catholic Church in May of last year. He is currently recovering in the Gemelli hospital in Rome. This hospital is well-known for providing care to popes, and it even features a high-security suite designed for such visits. The Guardian reported that the Pope is staying in a private-patient wing while his usual suite undergoes renovations. Cardinal Pietro Parolin, the Vatican secretary of state, visited the Pope before the surgery and described him as being very calm. Parolin told Rai News that the news was a surprise to everyone, but he expressed hope because the cancer was found quickly.
paragraphs.zh: 出生於芝加哥的教宗利奧於去年五月成為羅馬天主教會的領袖。他目前正在羅馬的傑梅利醫院（Gemelli hospital）休養。這家醫院以照護教宗聞名，甚至設有專為此類探訪設計的高維安套房。《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，由於他平時使用的套房正在進行翻修，教宗目前住在私人病房區。梵蒂岡國務卿帕羅林樞機（Cardinal Pietro Parolin）在手術前探視了教宗，形容他非常冷靜。帕羅林告訴義大利廣播電視公司新聞台（Rai News），這個消息讓每個人都感到驚訝，但他對此表示樂觀，因為癌症發現得很及時。

paragraphs.en: Following the surgery, all of the Pope’s official appointments have been cancelled until October 20. The weekly papal audience, which is a regular meeting where the Pope speaks to the public, will be led by Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle from the Philippines. Tagle was recently elected as the dean of the college of cardinals, which is the group of senior church leaders responsible for managing important church business.
paragraphs.zh: 手術後，教宗所有直到十月二十日的官方行程皆已取消。每週的教宗公開接見活動，也就是教宗與大眾對話的例行會議，將由來自菲律賓的塔格樞機（Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle）主持。塔格近期獲選為樞機團團長，該團體由負責管理教會重要事務的高階神職人員組成。

paragraphs.en: This health news comes after a difficult period for the Vatican. Pope Leo’s predecessor, Pope Francis, suffered from serious health issues before he passed away in April 2025. Francis had spent several weeks in the hospital for breathing problems, including bronchitis and pneumonia. Because of this recent history, the health of the current Pope is a matter of great interest to many people around the world.
paragraphs.zh: 這項健康消息傳出之際，梵蒂岡正處於一段艱難時期。教宗利奧的前任教宗方濟各（Pope Francis），在二零二五年四月過世前曾飽受嚴重的健康問題困擾。方濟各曾因呼吸道問題，包括支氣管炎和肺炎，在醫院住了好幾個星期。由於這段近期的歷史，現任教宗的健康狀況成為全球許多人高度關注的焦點。

paragraphs.en: Despite the diagnosis, those close to the Pope remain optimistic. Pope Leo is generally known for being in good health and enjoys playing sports, such as tennis. He often spends time at the papal retreat in Castel Gandolfo, a quiet area near Rome. Before this health challenge, the Pope had a busy schedule. He visited France in September and was planning a 12-day trip to South America in November to visit 10 different cities. It is not yet clear how this diagnosis will affect his future travel plans.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管確診罹癌，教宗身邊的人仍保持樂觀。教宗利奧通常被認為身體狀況良好，且喜愛網球等運動。他經常在羅馬附近寧靜的岡道爾夫堡（Castel Gandolfo）教宗避暑別墅度過時光。在這次健康挑戰之前，教宗的行程相當繁忙。他九月曾訪問法國，並計畫在十一月進行為期十二天的南美洲之旅，造訪十個不同的城市。目前尚不清楚這項診斷將如何影響他未來的出訪計畫。

paragraphs.en: For now, the focus remains on his recovery. The Vatican has been unusually transparent about the Pope’s condition, providing regular updates to the public. As the Pope rests, the church continues its work under the guidance of its senior officials. The fact that the cancer was caught early is seen as a positive sign by his medical team, who believe that such cases can often be resolved successfully when treated without delay. Supporters of the Pope have gathered at the hospital to show their care and concern during his time of recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，重點仍放在他的康復上。梵蒂岡對教宗的病情異常透明，持續向大眾提供最新消息。在教宗休養期間，教會在高階官員的指導下繼續運作。醫療團隊認為癌症及早發現是一個正面跡象，並相信若能及時治療，這類病例通常能成功痊癒。教宗的支持者們已聚集在醫院外，在他康復期間表達關懷與擔憂。
